title: Gremlins 3
overview: The third installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

title: Escape From Letterkenny
overview: A Metalhead makes a deal with God...  This film follows the intertwining meanderings of some typical Letterkenny residents over a few highly eventful days. Some are good, some are bad, some are morally vague. All are trapped in the same town. This film is about getting out. It's about breaking the shackles that hold you back by any means necessary, even if that means embracing utter chaos. It's about standing up to your outer demon. It's about friendship. It's about blossoming love. It's about dodgy-looking drugs. It will wreck your head. Or at the very least, it will make you question what kind of God you have.

title: born blue
overview: PLEASE NOTE: June 2027 is not a confirmed date. It is our target completion date and may change.  Born In Blue is produced using Unreal Engine. Unreal Engine is a trademark or registered trademark of Epic Games, Inc. All rights reserved.  Set in Mount Gambier, South Australia, the film follows Lumy, a young girl who witnesses her father’s sacrifice at the edge of the mysterious Blue Lake. Growing up with unhealed trauma and an unexplainable power tied to the water itself, Lumy retreats into science while being quietly hunted by forces she doesn’t fully understand.  Years later, she forms a deep connection with a broken but kindred soul, Ashton. Together, they become scientists and uncover a dangerous truth buried beneath the lake one that links Lumy’s existence to a phenomenon capable of reshaping reality. As the past resurfaces and the hunters return, Lumy must confront what her father died to protect. Born In Blue is a story of grief, survival, inheritance, and the cost of love.

title: Drodwel
overview: Paramedic-for-hire Drodwel and his robot companion Surly race through the sunset city in hope of saving the life of an injured revolutionary.

title: A Place in Hell
overview: A top criminal defense attorney, known for representing unlikeable clients in high-profile cases, is a relentless workhorse at her firm and fully expects to be named partner. When another attorney joins the firm, her job is put to the test and makes her question just how far she’ll go to protect it.

title: Plátano Champion
overview: A summary of the Dominican Republic's undefeated championship run in the 2013 World Baseball Classic.

title: Remain
overview: When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

title: Werwulf
overview: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

title: UK Holiday
overview: A UK Holiday is not just a journey; it’s an adventure filled with love, laughter, and unforgettable memories. The story revolves around Aakash, a kind-hearted and adventurous young man, who invites his sister Rekha from the USA to visit the UK for a long-awaited family reunion. Rekha, excited to escape her routine, is thrilled to meet their mother, Subhadra, and sisters Priyanka and Deepika, who already reside in the UK. Aakash ensures this holiday becomes a truly special experience. Together, they explore London’s iconic landmarks like the London Eye and Tower Bridge. The journey takes them to the natural wonder of Durdle Door in Dorset and the charming town of Aldershot. Along the way, they share stories, laughter, and moments of deep connection. This feature film captures the essence of holidays—taking a break, reconnecting with loved ones, and creating memories that last a lifetime. UK Holiday is a celebration of family, adventure, and the joy of togetherness.

title: How to Rob a Bank
overview: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

title: Stiletto
overview: A year after the grisly murder of a local exotic dancer, the victim’s sister, Lyric, searches for the serial killer responsible as he stalks and kills his favorite dancers on the night of the anniversary.

title: 3 Days Rising
overview: Living in self-imposed exile, Eric Usher battles his own conscience and reality itself as he must choose between his siblings, Rick and Cher, and his own salvation. Life and death consequences hinge on Eric's resolve and sanity as he navigates a world filled with strange interlopers climaxing with an explosively violent twist ending reveal Poe himself would be proud of.

title: Bunker Heights
overview: Citizens of a troubled city must navigate through an unforeseen crisis that threatens every walk of life.

title: is it just ambient noise
overview: a despondent teen is allured by his familial past

title: Mayookha
overview: Mayookha, a young professional living alone in a urban city. When a string of brutal murders rocks the city, targeting single women . She starts noticing strange occurrences around her apartment. She's convinced she's the next target.

title: Wilder
overview: Focusing on the life and legacy of actor Gene Wilder, told through the lens of Jordan Walker-Pearlman, the late actor’s nephew and a filmmaker in his own right.

title: Wounds
overview: Caleb, a young SFX makeup artist struggles to create realistic effects until he witnesses a brutal murder. Intrigued by what he saw, he descends into a psychological abyss as he takes on extreme measures to create his masterful effects.

title: Semicolon
overview: Two old friends reconnect after the unexpected death of their best friend.

title: Por ahí
overview: Nacho, Benja’s best friend, is gone. In his place, there is only an obscure object. Benja waits for him, trying to decipher the clues he left behind. But even if Nacho does return, there is no certainty that he will be the same as before.

title: Dream. Vol 1: «apple evil eye»
overview: A guy comes home. Sits on the couch. Picks up his phone. And falls asleep. What he sees in his dream isn't a dream. It's what he let inside himself while scrolling.

title: Subscriber
overview: An obnoxious real estate YouTuber takes his crew to a dilapidated farmhouse in Ohio, one of his recent purchases. Once they enter the remote house, they learn there is an entity not of this earth that refuses to let them leave…

title: Here We Go Again
overview: Farah and Milo take a trip to the place they met to try to jog Farah's memories.

title: Piss Up
overview: During a drunken altercation on a stag-do, Callum witnesses a dark side to the man who will soon marry his sister.

title: From the Ashes
overview: Two old buddies reunite to scatter the ashes of their friend and brother. Unbeknownst to them, they are soon to be visited by their late companion from beyond the grave.

title: To Catch a Stepfather
overview: After the death of her husband, Allison Simon finds love again with charming businessman Roger, but her son Eric quickly senses something sinister beneath his new stepfather's perfect facade.

title: Four Days In June
overview: A Midwest arts festival brings 60,000 people together for four days of music, food, and creativity, revealing how shared experiences can create rare common ground in a divided world.

title: Village Idiot
overview: "Village Idiot" is a sharp, heartfelt comedy-drama about a stubborn English grandmother, Barbara, who chains herself to her cottage to resist eviction by High Speed train developers. She then discovers that the company’s liaison sent to remove her is her estranged grandson, Peter. What follows is a clash between generations, class, and values: Barbara’s fierce attachment to home and identity versus Peter’s desperate need to hold onto his corporate job. As their battle becomes public, turning into a small-town spectacle of protest, press, and community chaos, both are forced to confront what “home” really means, and how love, pride, and belonging can both bind and divide a family. Witty, warm, and deeply human, "Village Idiot" captures rural England on the brink of change with equal parts humour and heartbreak.

title: Deadsight
overview: A cold-blooded contract killer known only as Deadsight executes without hesitation in order to clear his criminal record.

title: Journey
overview: Roberto is a young man trying to find his way back home to his family. His desire to push forward despite facing seemingly insurmountable obstacles is at the heart of his odyssey. Along his journey, Roberto is constantly faced with the temptation to quit and give in to defeat. However, it is the voice of those who came before him that fuels his passion for legacy.

title: Somethin' Stupid
overview: When Brynn discovers hat her ex-boyfriend will be living next door for another semester, she must muster the courage to tell him how she really feels.

title: Stream of Terror
overview: When her picture-perfect life is shattered by a series of live streamed murders, Tiffany must confront a masked killer targeting her inner circle-before she becomes the last to go live.

title: The Leftovers
overview: Four longtime friends, once a group of eight called the Clique,  recall the stories of their strong friendship side by side for the past 46 years, while also navigating the struggles of the loss of their spouses and best friends - proving that companionship is not only a comfort but a form of medicine against  loneliness and grief.

title: A Memory of Prague
overview: Reflecting upon the memories he made in Prague, Joseph revisits the footage he recorded during the holiday he spent there with his best friend.

title: Born Invincible
overview: A widowed mother trains her two sons in a mysterious martial art form to protect their village.

title: All of Us
overview: When Ruby Bridges Elementary opened in Washington State in 2020, its founding principal and staff made a radical choice: to educate every child in the same classroom, regardless of disability or support needs. Five years later, the school is seeing strong academic and social outcomes, without additional funding or staff. There was no magic fix – just a new model based on the belief that inclusion benefits everyone. All of Us is the story of a school that breaks the mold. A school that is unique, but shouldn't be.

title: Beware Boiúna
overview: Deep in the Amazon, a medical mission spirals into a fight for survival when Boiúna, a colossal ancient predator, awakens to reclaim her domain. In the jungle where nature holds absolute power, she decides who lives and who dies.

title: Livestream from Hell
overview: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

title: It's How It Ends
overview: After being expelled from college, Owen returns home to disappointed parents and leaves in the middle of the night with his younger sister Mara, wandering the city and stumbling into unexpected encounters.

title: out of sink
overview: A girl douches to prepare for sex with her partner in this psychological thriller.

title: Barn Family
overview: It takes a family to do a horse show!

title: Red Velvet
overview: After the death of her father, a young woman takes over the family baking business. One day, a pretty stranger visits her cupcake stall, and she begins to believe that love is something she must have. Something she must be consumed by.

title: Primetime
overview: A depressed student is given a holy Prime drink by an omnipotent god.

title: WWE/AAA Worlds Collide 2026: Chicago
overview: The 2026 Worlds Collide, also promoted as Worlds Collide: Chicago, was a professional wrestling live event co-produced by WWE and its sister promotion AAA. It was the sixth Worlds Collide under the WWE banner and the third between both promotions. It was filmed on September 26, 2026, at Allstate Arena in Rosemont, Illinois, USA, but aired on September 30.

title: WOLFSTORY (PILOT)
overview: Set in a dark world filled with ancient magic, WOLFSTORY follows three young wolves who set out on a quest to save their pack and rewrite their own stories.

title: Sales Assistant
overview: On a sales day, a 28-year-old Latina migrant works at a fast fashion store in the Netherlands, surviving a job she cannot afford to lose as her body starts to resist.

title: Wir Sind Am Leben - Das Berlin Musical
original_title: Wir Sind Am Leben - Das Berlin Musical
overview: A new German musical by Peter Plate & Ulf Leo Sommer  After the great successes of Plate & Sommer, the author duo is back with a new Berlin musical – powerful, emotional and full of music that remains.  WE ARE ALIVE is a fast-paced, comic and deeply moving musical about departure, cohesion and joie de vivre. A night of laughing, paused – and laugh again.  A musical that you have to see in Berlin – because this city finds its voice here.

title: Ang Bagong Toy ni Boy
overview: A boy receives a mysterious package that contains a digital dress-up game that seems to have bizarre mechanics

title: The Compass
overview: A hand reaches out. His reaches back.

title: Globe
overview: Globe is a cinematic folktale about identity, belonging, and resistance, set amid the tribal land struggles of Kerala. Seen through Kariyan, a young tribal boy, the film reflects the deep bond indigenous communities share with their land and the alienation they face in urban society. Rooted in Attappadi, the story subtly reveals ancestral dispossession and cultural erasure, urging reflection on justice, dignity, and the right to remain in one’s birthplace.

title: Changed Forever
overview: CHANGED FOREVER tells the raw and inspiring true story of Alexis, a woman consumed by the darkness of addiction, teetering on the brink of self-destruction. Her life is a whirlwind of bad choices and devastating consequences, leaving her isolated and hopeless. Just when she believes all is lost, a flicker of faith ignites within her. Driven by desperation, her unwavering faith culminates in a profound, life-altering encounter with God, an experience that shatters her old life and rebuilds her from the ground up. CHANGED FOREVER follows Alexis's arduous journey to sobriety, healing, and ultimately, redemption. More than just a story of overcoming addiction, CHANGED FOREVER is a testament to the transformative power of faith and prayer, offering a beacon of hope to anyone struggling to find their own new beginning.

title: NOSEBLEED
overview: When unresolved trauma resurfaces, the restless Maya is forced to confront her spiraling nature, both that of victim and that of perpetrator.  NOSEBLEED is a raw, semi-autobiographical dance film in which the border between reality and fiction blurs in a provocative exploration of desire and power.

title: Fuck Mr Flanagan
overview: A journey into the woods causes two stoners to question their friendship and purpose in life - while they try to avoid a devious figure named Mr Flanagan.

title: Little Hollywood, Tennessee
overview: Each summer, twenty-four high school students across Tennessee are selected for one shot at creating a full-blown narrative motion picture. For one month, they live like college students, make difficult creative choices, and find out what they're made of when surrounded by skilled peers. On the precipice of the rest of their lives, these students navigate disagreement, impostor syndrome, and self-worth in this coming-of-age film that's a must-see for anyone with the creative urge.

title: Meta
overview: When two young adults meet in the laundry room, they get into a relationship but they soon realize the world they live in has a lot more to do with the way they are able to give and receive love.

title: Uprooted
overview: Just as a couple prepares to welcome their long-awaited child, a devoted couple meets a troubled teen whose wounded heart resists faith. Their paths intertwine in a story of love, healing, and unexpected grace.

title: Pumpkin Regatta Romance
overview: When their fathers refuse to move past a disagreement, Nadine, daughter of the boat shop owner, and Ethan, a pumpkin farmer, team up to heal the feud and revive the town's Pumpkin Regatta.

title: The Shortest Forever
overview: Alex leaves for her dream job abroad tomorrow. Before she goes, she and her boyfriend Justin share one final  date at her favorite restaurant — an attempt to make the night feel normal. Afterward, parked outside and  waiting for her sister to pick her up, the two find themselves with nothing left to do but talk.  What starts as a lighthearted trip down memory lane slowly shifts beneath its own weight. Old moments  resurface. Certain topics get carefully avoided. Then inevitably, unavoidably, confronted. A ten-minute wait  stretches into an eternity as Alex and Justin are quietly forced to reckon with what they're each giving up — and  what, if anything, they're willing to say out loud before the headlights pull up.

title: Wild
overview: Wild is a survival dramedy set in the breath-taking yet unforgiving Scottish Highlands. Lou, Dev, and Alistair, three old friends clinging to their annual wild camping tradition, begin with banter, nostalgia, and amateur vlogging, but soon unravel into a battle of egos, secrets, and survival when they get lost, food runs short, and friendships fracture. At once funny, poignant, and unsettling, "Wild" explores the line between adventure and recklessness, and how toxic masculinity has become a huge part of the epidemic decline in men’s mental health.

title: Buzzkill
overview: A group of sorority sisters end up trapped with a murderer. Nora’s tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she’s drunk.

title: The Beekeepers
overview: A short documentary about the beekeeping community in County Louth

title: anthos
overview: In a scorched world, two bodies open themselves to what may grow. A sensual, poetic short film about finding tenderness amid the wasteland.

title: LORG
overview: In this animation, a young girl tries to come to terms with the death of her cat. What follows is a journey through various mourning rituals and surrealist worlds, each offering a different way of coping with loss.

title: The Route to Cappyness
overview: A filmmaker embarks on a global adventure to uncover the viral fascination of the capybara, including exploring how they have become cultural symbols of serenity in Japan.

title: + Add Friend
overview: A working man must confront his secret shame as his online activity unravels into his personal life- following an intimate encounter with an anonymous internet user.

title: Dogwood
overview: "DOGWOOD" is a tale of survival, revenge, and the enduring strength of a mother's love as Harriet confronts the darkest depths of human nature to protect what is rightfully hers.

title: plasma.mov
overview: An experimental Canadian short film capturing a severe lightning storm over Lake Garda (Lago di Garda), Italy.

title: Beneath It All
overview: Between takes on her first feature film, actress Remi is suddenly given direction that could significantly alter the course of her life. With only ten minutes to decide whether or not to stand up to the director, the film takes an unexpected turn.

title: The Swallow
overview: Ziggy and her four friends journey out on a camping trip to a picturesque remote forest. But trespassing into an off-limits area, they awaken an uncanny terror in the woods... and a ravenous hunger from within the Earth. Soon, the ground itself is trying to swallow anything and anyone it comes into contact with and Ziggy and her friends have nowhere to run as every trembling step they take could be their last.

title: Chow Time
overview: In pursuit of the perfect meal, Brighton goes to battle with his six roommates over control of the kitchen.

title: The Florist
overview: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

title: The Love Hypothesis
overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

title: The Mirror Without Image
overview: In 1995, an offshore survey in the Timor Sea detected something that should not exist: a grid of streets and buildings, 280 metres below the surface. What the divers found there was a replica of a Japanese city, on the wrong side of the world...

title: Dance Film
overview: This short animated film playfully upends the history of avant garde choreography films by focusing its attention on the spectator of a dance instead of the dancer herself (the filmmaker, Kelly). In some ways it's about watching others watching and what it means to become conscious of our own role as spectators. In other ways it's just a colorful film about a very happy baby watching with delight as her mother dances.

title: The Master of Many Worlds
overview: A dreamlike glimpse of a nightwatchman and his partner on their rounds.

title: The Waiting
overview: The Waiting is a short fictional film based on true events, inspired by and filmed in the home of Ferdonije Çerkezi.

title: One Last Shot
overview: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

title: Eons
overview: A study of time's dark-flowering unknown center.

title: Fight of Fury 2 Retaliation
overview: Brandon exerts great effort and patience to rescue his daughter, abducted by a sex trafficker named Brutal. He comes so close to meeting his nemesis, but the villain escapes to avoid capture by the authorities, who he fears more than Brandon. The search must continue, or all is lost!

title: Lintasan
overview: Set at a lighthouse near the Malaysia-Singapore Second Link, a Singaporean woman is forced to choose between her home country and her lover’s after her Malaysian boyfriend’s sudden proposal threatens to pull them toward opposite shores.

title: Nimesh Patel: Buy The Dip
overview: In his first Netflix special, Nimesh Patel talks rebelling against his traditional parents and why you should never go viral in India.

title: Harmony Korine is A Weird Old Man
original_title: Harmony Korine is A Weird Old Man
overview: A four part ambiguation of "weirdness" in relation to the sublime. A sensory ode to incongruity. A brief and romantic gesture toward un-understanding. A prayer to the anti-self.

title: Keirra
overview: A lonely student, raised under her mother’s suffocating control, finds love and confidence through a film that finally lets her be seen. But when a humiliating video is exposed, her breakdown becomes a reckoning — and the girl who wanted attention learns what it means to be unforgettable.

title: Protein: Everything You Need to Know
original_title: Protein: Everything You Need to Know
overview: From protein pitfalls to considered choices, Gemma Atkinson, Dr Jack Mosley and Lucy Watson cut through the hype to discover the truth about the consumer health obsession

title: Spidernado
overview: A quiet countryside is plunged into chaos when a monstrous tornado tears across the region—only to reveal something far worse riding in its winds.

title: REO: The Dangerous Peak
overview: A documentary following a young mountaineer, Yashwanth Naik, on an expedition to Mount Reo Purgyil in Himachal Pradesh.

title: Pathetic Fallacy
overview: A young widower arrives in a new-age mountain town in search of cosmic answers and a chance to heal. Instead, he finds an outlandish murderer and a forest of demonic spirits who offer a horrific bargain: the power to cheat death at a nightmarish cost.

title: Sport Star
overview: An aging black high school football star, living a quotidian life and married to his high school sweetheart in a small town, reminisces over a long-lost lover - a man he once shared the football field with.

title: Heart of the Beast
overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

title: The Vanishing Song
overview: Cut off from his kind, a lone gibbon calls out from a vanishing forest patch in the heart of a Malaysian city — and a team races to reach him before time runs out.

title: Mackenzie
overview: Eleven-year-old Juniper runs away from home and sets out across the Utah desert, determined to reach California and marry her television crush, Mackenzie Astin. Along the way, her unlikely journey becomes a search for connection, independence, and a place to belong.

title: CHASING RAHUL
overview: In modern-day Bangalore, Sama sets on to chase the old-school romance she grew up believing in, all while discovering the little beauties of Bangalore city.

title: Sweetest Day
overview: ‘Survivor girl’ Mindy prepares for the battle of her life against the undead confederate soldier that nearly killed her once before.

title: Pixel generation(s)
overview: The original video is filmed again and again.

title: Cycle centrifuge
overview: An essay film on deprivation, in which physical isolation becomes a space for inner escape.

title: Juvenescence
overview: An Australian coming of age comedy follows four teenagers navigating their final days at Edgewater High and all that comes with it.

title: Zippy's House
overview: A troubled teen is forced to attend his strange classmate's birthday.

title: Fear of Dogs
overview: A routine immersion into the greys is interrupted by the figure of a dog, whose  muzzle attempts to uncover the backstage.

title: the is of it
overview: “There is much to say that I don’t know how to say. The words are lacking. But I refuse to invent new ones: those that already exist must say what can be said and what is forbidden. Beyond thought there are no words: it is itself. My painting has no words: it is beyond thought. In this land of the is-itself I am pure crystalline ecstasy. It is itself. I am myself. You are yourself.” - Clarice Lispector

title: The note
overview: After finding a 100-dirham note outside his apartment building, Ayan must decide whether to keep it or return it. What seems like a simple choice sets off a chain of events that forces him and his friends to confront the consequences of their actions.

title: Don't Be Yourself
overview: A socially anxious teenage boy attends a party accompanied by his overconfident, aggressive friend who pushes him to be a better version of himself and act “confident” at any cost.

title: Bobo Saves Christmas
overview: A struggling dad adopts a scruffy dog to reconnect with his daughter, only to have Bobo turn his life upside down. When Bobo goes missing Christmas Eve, an unlikely community comes together to find the dog who quietly changed their lives.

title: Madonna
overview: A purity obsessed man, Vincent, and his sex doll wife, Suzanne, must navigate their relationship as Vincent develops a delusional para-social relationship with the secretary at his work.

title: Concerto Muerto
overview: A pianist learns what it's like to really be INSIDE his piano...

title: Infinitely Dense
overview: Tom, a painfully pragmatic solipsist, disenchanted with his life, employs an augmented reality system to rejuvenate his life, only to discover the unintended dark and disturbing consequence of manipulating reality.

title: Dead Drop
overview: A group of strangers board a freight elevator and find themselves trapped in an ever-worsening life-and-death predicament that ultimately reveals they are all linked together in a sinister, supernatural, or even biblical nightmare.

title: In Her You'll Find Sanctuary
overview: After the arrival of a nun with mystical visions, Sister Miriam becomes envious of her rival's sudden notoriety and begins falsifying miracles in a grotesque game of spiritual cat-and-mouse.

title: Resident Evil
overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

title: Building
overview: Set during the construction of the World Trade Center in 1970s New York. After a co-worker starts spreading false rumors about him and the boss' daughter, an electrician retaliates with an escalating series of anonymous prank notes. The notes spread as gossip through the crew, sparking a psychological war of rumors and retaliation amid the daily grind of construction work.

title: 14 Days in Gainesville
overview: The fall of 1990 in Gainesville, Florida, heralds the arrival of new head football coach Steve Spurrier, the former Heisman winner who promises to breathe new life into the program. But that enthusiasm is clouded by the darkness of another new arrival: a serial killer who preys on the community, killing five students in quick succession. Over a shocking and unforgettable two-week span, the UF community grapples with unspeakable horror and prepares for a season opener like no other, while clinging to the hope of better days to come.

title: WILDLIFE FRIENDS
overview: Telling the story of "Henry" A baby gibbon that was taken from its mother's chest and kept in a cage to be sold as a pet illegally , the "Wildlife Detective Gang" had to join forces to infiltrate and carry out a terrible mission. To rescue and bring it back to the natural forest.

title: Sanatorium 43
overview: Two scientist friends are sent to a decaying sanatorium to investigate a young patient suffering from catatonia. But as they uncover the truth, they realize Sanatorium 43 hides a far darker secret.

title: Yes Block
overview: When a group of four college friends realize their final semester together is slipping away, they make a pact to say “Yes” to every invitation, challenge, and crazy idea that comes their way in their final Block at Colorado College.

title: Egress
overview: The film follows a mysterious "Shadow Man" who works inside a cryptic, industrial factory setting

title: Freddy’s Back
overview: “FREDDY’S BACK" stars Michael Leavy (Terrifier, STREAM) as 'Freddy Krueger' alongside Allison Pittel (Screamboat) as 'Natalie', in an original nightmare sequence that puts Leavy beneath the fedora and into full Freddy prosthetics for the first time.
